messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: alias=production-canary -> model:model-v5.2+tokenizerB at run_id=run-2026-03-15-336123. Artifact promotion triggered. watchlist=canary
eli-ml: FYI this includes the new weightset and tokenizer B. Local evals looked fine but tokenizer change is non-trivial. Please watch for short completions / tokenization errors.
ryan-oncall: I'm watching metrics now. will keep console open. ping me if you see anything that needs fast rollback.
incident-bot: [ALERT] canary-error-rate > 3% (5xx/tokenize-errors) on production-canary (alert_id=ALERT-336123-A). Paging ryan-oncall @here
sarah-sre: Seeing a spike in parse failures coming from the canary hosts: logs show repeated error: "TokenizerError: UnknownByteSequence \u0000 at offset 12" for ~120 requests in last minute.
cs-jane: @eli-ml got an inbound from a customer — two integrations reported truncated completions and weird non-UTF8 characters. They called support.
eli-ml: That matches an immediate hypothesis: artifact alias was pointed at model-v5.2 but the promoted artifact included an older tokenizer binary due to a tag aliasing mistake in the promotion job. I suspect the artifact manifest's tokenizer_tag differs from the weights_tag.
ops-maya: Can you confirm the artifact manifest? pulling manifests from storage now: 
```
# sample manifest keys
model-v5.2/manifest.json -> {
  "weights_tag": "weights-v5.2-q8",
  "tokenizer_tag": "tokenizer-B"
}
promoted/production-canary/manifest.json -> {
  "weights_tag": "weights-v5.2-q8",
  "tokenizer_tag": "tokenizer-A-old"
}
```
ops-maya: yep — promoted alias includes tokenizer-A-old. that explains mismatch.
ryan-oncall: Paging oncall-infra for an immediate alias flip. We'll rollback the alias to the previously known-good canary while we investigate promotion job.
eli-ml: Agreed. Plan: 1) flip alias back to previous canary artifact (model-v5.1) 2) pause auto-promote feature flag 3) run forensic on promotion job that wrote the wrong manifest.
ops-maya: Running alias flip now ->
```
# run via rcli
rcli alias set production-canary model:model-v5.1 --reason "emergency rollback: tokenizer mismatch"
```
ops-maya: rcli returned: queued on 12 hosts
ryan-oncall: alias flip progress: 12/12 hosts updated, health checks re-registered.
deploy-bot: alias update complete for production-canary -> model-v5.1 (rollback_id=rb-3361239999). Telemetry: canary_error_rate: 3.1% -> 0.4% in 120s. Latency: 95p jumped to 320ms during flip, back to 90ms.
sarah-sre: Confirming error rate dropped on all canary hosts. Sample logs from post-rollback: no TokenizerError in last 5m.
cs-jane: Customer update: notified the two impacted accounts with initial incident note, offered a follow-up incident report. They confirmed service is back to normal for them. 👍
product-luca: What was the customer-visible window? Need to draft a short postmortem blurb for CSMs.
ryan-oncall: From alert graphs: elevated tokenization/parsing errors from 3361239999 -> 3361240042 (~143s). We'll mark ~2.5 minutes total customer impact window; some requests may have retried longer.
eli-ml: Root cause: promotion job used a stale manifest lookup when populating promoted/production-canary. The promotion script resolves artifact tags by timestamp and a recent manual deploy had overwritten a staging tokenizer tag. The weightset was correct but tokenizer file reference pointed to a legacy build.
eli-ml: Immediate action items: 1) revert promotion script to strict tag matching (no timestamp fallback) 2) add manifest checksum assertion during promote 3) expand canary validation to run tokenizer roundtrip tests against random customer prompts.
ryan-oncall: Also enabling a kill-switch for auto-promote to prevent automatic future promotions until we have a fix.
```
# toggle feature flag
flags-cli set model.auto_promote false --actor ryan-oncall
```
ryan-oncall: flag set success. model.auto_promote=false
incident-bot: Incident created INC-3361239999. Severity: P1 (customer-facing partial degradation). On-call: ryan-oncall. Escalation: required. Postmortem: scheduled in #postmortems at 09:00 PT tomorrow.
sarah-sre: I'll collect host-level logs and the promotion job's run history (CI-artifacts job #4572). tagging for follow-up: ops-maya, eli-ml, product-luca.
ops-maya: Created a short runbook snippet for emergency alias rollbacks and validated the rcli path. I'll submit a PR to the promotion pipeline to add the checksum assert. PR: https://git.redwood/promotion/pull/182
cs-jane: I've created incident reference for CSMs and posted an initial note in the customer portal: "We experienced a brief degradation affecting a subset of completions due to an artifact promotion mismatch. The issue has been mitigated. We will follow up with technical details and an incident reference." (ref INC-3361239999)
product-luca: Good. please add a short timeline + affected customers list to the postmortem. We'll follow up with credits for impacted accounts.
eli-ml: Quick repro for devs: 
```
# fetch promoted manifest
aws s3 cp s3://promoted/production-canary/manifest.json - | jq .
# compare to expected manifest in model bucket
aws s3 cp s3://models/model-v5.2/manifest.json - | jq .
```
eli-ml: We saw tokenizer_tag mismatch in the two manifests above. Also adding a unit test to the promotion job to compare tokenizer binary checksums.
ryan-oncall: Handoff: I'm on-call for the next 30m to monitor. After that Sarah will be primary for follow-up. If anything regresses page the infra team.
sarah-sre: Acknowledged. I'll take the post-incident actions and coordinate the postmortem.
incident-bot: Handoff noted. Postmortem channel created: #postmortems/INC-3361239999
cs-jane: Closing loop with the two accounts; they accepted the note and asked to be kept updated. I'll include the postmortem link when it's available.
product-luca: Thanks everyone. short action items: instrument promotion pipeline, kill auto-promote, extend canary checks. We'll capture costs and customer impact in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
eli-ml: I'll draft the technical writeup for the postmortem (root cause, manifest diff, fix PRs). tagging ops-maya for review.
ryan-oncall: Final note: alert silence set for ALERT-336123-A for 4 hours to avoid duplicates while we correlate logs. Reopen if new signals appear.
sarah-sre: Incident summary pinned to thread. moving to postmortem work now.
